 Leeds look like the only side that's going to score this afternoon as Harry Wilson sneaks into the box but his low cross is turned behind.

 Post published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Brentford 0-0 Nottm Forest 
 Igor Thiago and Liam Delap could both do with a goal.
 Both strikers have scored just once in the league this season and are lacking in confidence in front of goal. Thiago has just swept a strike wide, while Delap follows that up at the other end with a blocked effort.
 27 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Should be 1-1!
 The corner comes in and Iliman Ndiaye leaps highest and he should score but he can't get his header on target.
 107 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Hull City 0-0 Ipswich Town 
 That Ipswich penalty shout saw Nobel Mendy have a hold of Dara O'Shea's shirt but a theatrical fall to the floor did not help the Town captain's case and nothing was given. It is a risky game that Mendy is playing though.
 16 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Goalkeeper needs to do better' published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Coventry City 1-0 Sunderland 
 Ellen White 
Former England striker on Final Score 
 Really poor defending. Sunderland had a good chance beforehand from a corner but it was a poor clearance and it was a brilliant finish into the bottom corner by Tatsuhiro Sakamoto. 
 Goalkeeper Robin Roefs needs to do better. 
 29 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 As it stands... published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Manchester United update. The Red Devils are now sitting in the bottom three. 
 159 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:22 GMT 15:22 GMT 
 Coventry 0-0 Sunderland 
 Brian Brobbey with a big opportunity to equalise but he drags his shot wide.
 So close.
 38 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:22 GMT 15:22 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 A little one-two down the right between Enzo Fernandez and Elliot Anderson and Anderson takes one touch too many to be able to get the shot away from a tight angle.
 Corner to City.
 50 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Bournemouth 0-0 Leeds 
 Leeds have started this game well. They look bang on it when they have the ball and are limiting Bournemouth when they come forward themselves. 
 Daniel Farke will be delighted. 
 253 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chema Andres goes into the book for a foul on Ayyoub Bouaddi.
 The referee has deemed that to be a promising attack so the Brighton man goes into the book.
 61 76 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Brentford 0-0 Nottm Forest 
 Nottingham have started on the front foot against Brentford.
 Morgan Gibbs-White takes a pop at goal from the edge of the box, but his shot is deflected out for a corner which Brentford defend initially.
 The ball makes its way back into the box with a lovely delivery from Neco Williams and Jair Cunha can't sort his feet out to bundle it in.
 37 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:20 GMT 15:20 GMT 
 Hull City 0-0 Ipswich Town 
 Hull get away with one. The ball is played into goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis but he takes ages to clear his lines as Emersonn closes him down. In the end, under pressure, Tzolakis has to produce a spin and is very relieved to nudge the ball into safety.
 Ipswich come again and Abdoul Ouattara's low ball into the middle from the right is sent behind by a sliding John Egan for a corner to the visitors.
 Town captain Dara O'Shea then wants a penalty when he hits the deck from the following set piece but referee Thomas Kirk says no and there's nothing from Neil Davies on VAR duty to change that.
 19 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 15:19 GMT 15:19 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Ayari running right past Elliot Anderson to slot in unmarked. Terrible defending from the City midfielder. For 120m+ you'd expect him to do the basics of football, like track your man.
 Neil 
 245 80 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:18 GMT 15:18 GMT 
 Bournemouth 0-0 Leeds 
 The ball rolls really nicely for Ryan Christie to strike first time but it's blocked by a Leeds body. 
 That would've definitely troubled James Trafford. 
 71 64 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Coventry 1-0 Sunderland published at 15:18 GMT 15:18 GMT 
 Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (17 mins) 
 Image source, Reuters What a lovely goal that is.
 The ball comes into the box and it's sloppy from Sunderland as Trai Hume fails to clear the ball properly and it falls to the feet of Tatsuhiro Sakamoto , who sweeps into the bottom far corner with his foot.
 A lovely finish but the visitors will be disappointed.
 761 307 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Ayari 'sweeps' the ball into the net published at 15:16 GMT 15:16 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 I think Yasin Ayari wins the free-kick initially with a little nutmeg on Elliott Anderson.
 From the free-kick it's a quick ball out to the wide right, and then fizzed across brilliantly to the back post.
 Matheus Nunes misses it completely and the ball sits for Ayari, who is six-yards-out. He composes himself, sweeps the ball past the goalkeeper with his left foot.
 239 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:16 GMT 15:16 GMT 
 Hull City 0-0 Ipswich Town 
 Ipswich have had 75% of the ball at Hull and ex-Tigers winger Jaden Philogene tries to thread a pass through to striker Emersonn, but the Brazilian can't gather it and the hosts clear. Hull yet to get close to Christian Walton in the away goal.
 67 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:16 GMT 15:16 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Image source, Reuters Manchester City win a corner and it very nearly reaches Erling Haaland at the back post.
 Instead it's another corner for the hosts after a quick penalty check to see if Lewis Dunk handballed it. He didn't.
 Josko Gvardiol heads the second corner well wide.
 60 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:16 GMT 15:16 GMT 
 Bournemouth 0-0 Leeds 
 Ellen White 
Former England striker on Final Score 
 The cross comes in for Dominic Calvert-Lewin and as he's struck it, it's hit the goalkeeper and then come back and hit him. 
 So that's unfortunately why it's been disallowed for Leeds.
